title: improve-orion-s-own-workflow-tooling-make-orion-draft-derive-mai
goal: Improve Orion's own workflow tooling: make orion draft derive maintenance-aware tasks (reproduce the failure, implement the fix, verify gates) for bug-fix/upgrade/refactor goals instead of generic build templates, and shorten change folder names to 3-4 significant words by stripping leading action verbs and stopwords from the prompt. No new user-facing features; all existing tests must keep passing.
constraints: Runtime stays zero-dependency; coverage thresholds 80/80/80/70 must keep passing; vitest pool stays forks; no new external API/behavior changes; existing tests must pass unchanged where they assert feature behavior
